Planetary roller-screw production depends on ultra-precision CNC thread-grinding equipment (sub-3-micron internal/external thread grinding); the grinder supply and grinding expertise are the upstream bottleneck.

Drake Manufacturing builds CNC internal thread grinders and ball-nut/ballscrew grinders for the ball-screw and linear-motion industries; modeled as an upstream thread-grinding equipment supplier candidate.
PTG Holroyd builds high-precision screw and thread grinding machines (world's most accurate helical components); modeled as an upstream thread-grinding equipment supplier candidate.

Shenzhen PICEA Motion (formerly Han's Motion) makes precision harmonic-drive / strain-wave reducers marketed for humanoid-robot joints; modeled as a strain-wave reducer supplier candidate, not a confirmed humanoid BOM claim.

JL MAG Rare-Earth is the top-ranked global sintered-NdFeB permanent-magnet maker and in 2025 stood up a dedicated humanoid-robot magnetic-component business unit; modeled as a magnet-supply exposure candidate, not a confirmed humanoid BOM claim.
Shin-Etsu Chemical makes NdFeB (Nd-Fe-B) sintered magnets used in industrial servomotors/linear motors; modeled as a magnet-supply exposure candidate, not a confirmed humanoid BOM claim.

Proterial (ex-Hitachi Metals) pioneered and mass-produces NEOMAX Nd-Fe-B sintered magnets for motors and a heavy-rare-earth-saving grade; modeled as a magnet-supply exposure candidate, not a confirmed humanoid BOM claim.

MP Materials began trial production of sintered NdFeB magnets at its Fort Worth Independence facility (~1,000 t/yr target, late-2025 ramp); modeled as a nascent ex-China magnet-supply exposure candidate, not a confirmed humanoid BOM claim.

maxon makes EC frameless DT torque motors and integrated HEJ joint actuators explicitly targeting humanoids/quadrupeds/exoskeletons; modeled as a frameless-motor exposure candidate, not a confirmed humanoid BOM claim.

Broadcom absolute magnetic motor-feedback encoders are a supplier candidate for robot joint / hand-actuator position feedback. Exposure candidate, not a confirmed humanoid BOM claim.

Netzer contactless capacitive absolute hollow-shaft encoders are a supplier candidate for humanoid robot-arm joint feedback (documented in NASA Robonaut 2 humanoid). Exposure candidate, not a confirmed commercial-humanoid BOM claim.

ATI Industrial Automation (a Novanta division) six-axis force/torque sensors are a supplier candidate for humanoid wrist/hand force-torque sensing. Exposure candidate; incumbent in industrial robotic F/T but no confirmed humanoid-OEM BOM claim found this round.

Bota Systems compact 6-axis force/torque sensors are a supplier candidate for humanoid force-torque and fingertip sensing; vendor explicitly markets to humanoid robots. Exposure candidate, not a confirmed named-OEM BOM claim.

Sunrise Instruments (SRI) sells a dedicated humanoid-robot six-axis force/torque sensor line and is a supplier candidate for humanoid force-torque sensing. Exposure candidate, not a confirmed named-OEM BOM claim.

XELA Robotics uSkin three-axis tactile skin sensors are a supplier candidate for humanoid fingertip/phalange/palm tactile arrays; integrated into the Tesollo DG-5F anthropomorphic hand. Exposure candidate, not a confirmed named-humanoid-OEM BOM claim.

PaXini multidimensional tactile sensors (PX-6AX) and tactile dexterous hands are a supplier candidate for humanoid fingertip/hand tactile sensing. Exposure candidate, not a confirmed third-party-OEM BOM claim (PaXini also builds its own hands/robots).

Bosch Sensortec MEMS IMUs (BMI088 class) are a supplier candidate for humanoid IMU/attitude sensing; vendor names agile humanoids among robotics targets. Exposure candidate, not a confirmed named-OEM BOM claim.

Hesai JT-series 3D robotics LiDAR is a supplier candidate for the humanoid depth/LiDAR perception layer; named only LiDAR firm on Morgan Stanley Humanoid Tech 25. Exposure candidate, not a confirmed named-humanoid-OEM BOM claim.

RoboSense Active Camera (AC1/AC2) fused LiDAR+RGB+IMU vision is a supplier candidate for the humanoid depth/LiDAR perception layer; secured an order from a European humanoid robotics firm. Exposure candidate.

Orbbec Gemini-series stereo-vision depth cameras are a supplier candidate for the humanoid depth-camera perception layer (featured in HONOR's humanoid). Exposure candidate; reported >70% China service-robot 3D-vision share.
Orbbec Gemini stereo-vision 3D cameras are a supplier candidate for the humanoid stereo RGB camera module (HONOR humanoid; Reachy 2). Exposure candidate.

RealSense stereo depth cameras (D4xx; D455 in Agility Digit) are a supplier candidate for the humanoid depth-camera perception layer; RealSense reports working with ~60% of AMR and humanoid developers. Exposure candidate.

claim: Qualcomm markets the Dragonwing IQ10 series as a premium-tier onboard AI compute ('brain of the robot') processor for full-size humanoid robots; merchant alternative to NVIDIA Jetson Thor.
NXP's i.MX 95 applications processor serves as a machine-vision edge-perception compute node delivering high-bandwidth data to the humanoid robot brain (developed with NVIDIA).
NXP supplies a humanoid motor-control solution built on a kinematic chain of i.MX RT1180 crossover MCUs aggregated by an S32J TSN switch connecting to the robot brain.
Rockchip's RK3588/RK3588S SoC is the adopted onboard compute/'brain' platform in multiple named Chinese humanoid robots (e.g. AgiBot/ZhiYuan Lingxi X2, LimX Oli).
D-Robotics' RDK S100 is the first single-SoC platform integrating robot 'brain' (compute) and 'cerebellum' (control) for humanoid-robot developers (80-128 TOPS).
Infineon supplies gate drivers, current sensors, and a GaN-based motor-control chip set for humanoid-robot motor control (Aug 2025 NVIDIA collaboration).
Infineon's PSOC Control C3 MCU family implements field-oriented motor control for humanoid robots and bridges to NVIDIA Jetson Thor via the Holoscan Sensor Bridge.
EPC's EPC91122 3-phase BLDC motor-drive inverter evaluation board is engineered specifically for humanoid robot joint applications (GaN power stage for joint actuator drive).

Microchip's dsPIC33 DSC-based integrated motor drivers fuse a DSC, a three-phase MOSFET gate driver, and LIN/CAN FD into one device for FOC BLDC/PMSM motor control (robotics/industrial-class; humanoid design win not yet demonstrated on source).
